scientific_queries.note: Residual-conservation replication plus a residual-transfer test on data in hand.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round's own robustness check overrode a mechanical TRUE flag, which is the challenge that mattered here.

decisions.H056_status: the mechanical flag was TRUE only because the paired CI lower bound is 1.2e-18; the median gain is 0 and 34% of units get worse, so it is recorded as NOT established

trade_off: transferring the residual raises the top-10 point estimate while lowering global Spearman (CI excludes 0): additive ordering is best for the bulk, the interaction lives in the tail
operational_difference_from_R13: R13 measured the residual against Bliss single-agent additivity on validation plates (29 pairs, rho 0.353); here it is against a fitted additive model on 351-pair plates (25 cell pairs, rho 0.596). Same family, different operationalisation, so this is a replication in spirit plus an upward revision, not a repeat measurement.

register_updates.C12: upgraded: residual conservation 0.596 (25/25 positive) on the high-diversity design, with the operationalisation difference stated

pattern: this is the fourth consecutive round where a modelling device fails to improve the decision-relevant ordering (R14 shrinkage/dimension, R17 rule boundary, R18-19 target overlap, R24 residual transfer); the next round should change the question rather than the method
